00047 BinaryOpUGenInternal::BinaryOpUGenInternal(UGen const& leftOperand, UGen const& rightOperand, int channel) throw()
00048 :   UGenInternal(NumInputs)
00049 {   
00050     
00051     if(channel < 0)
00052     {
00053         inputs[LeftOperand] = leftOperand;
00054         inputs[RightOperand] = rightOperand;
00055     }
00056     else
00057     {
00058         int numLeftChannels = leftOperand.getNumChannels();
00059         int numRightChannels = rightOperand.getNumChannels();
00060         UGenInternal* leftInternal = leftOperand.getInternalUGen(channel % numLeftChannels);
00061         UGenInternal* rightInternal = rightOperand.getInternalUGen(channel % numRightChannels);
00062         
00063         inputs[LeftOperand] = UGen(leftInternal->getChannelInternal(channel), channel);
00064         inputs[RightOperand] = UGen(rightInternal->getChannelInternal(channel), channel);
00065     }
00066 }

00154 
00155 BinaryDivideUGen::BinaryDivideUGen(UGen const& leftOperand, UGen const& rightOperand) throw() 
00156 {   
00157     const int numRightChannels = rightOperand.getNumChannels();
00158     const int numLeftChannels = leftOperand.getNumChannels();
00159     
00160     if(numLeftChannels > numRightChannels) 
00161         initInternal(numLeftChannels); 
00162     else 
00163         initInternal(numRightChannels); 
00164     
00165     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++) 
00166     { 
00167         const int rightIndex = i % numRightChannels;
00168         if(rightOperand.isConst(rightIndex))
00169         {
00170             // special case where the right operand is a scalar
00171             // use multiplication by the reciprocal instead
00172             float reciprocalRightOperand = 1.f / rightOperand.getValue(rightIndex);
00173             internalUGens[i] = new BinaryMultiplyUGenInternal(leftOperand, reciprocalRightOperand); 
00174         }
00175         else
00176             internalUGens[i] = new BinaryDivideUGenInternal(leftOperand, rightOperand); 
00177     }
00178 }

00181 void BinaryDivideUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw() 
00182 { 
00183     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize(); 
00184     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData(); 
00185     float* leftOperandSamples = inputs[LeftOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel); 
00186     float* rightOperandSamples = inputs[RightOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel); 
00187     
00188     while(numSamplesToProcess--) 
00189     { 
00190         // maybe should "zap" the output?
00191         *outputSamples++ = *leftOperandSamples++ / *rightOperandSamples++; 
00192     }
00193 } 
00194 
00195 void BinaryDivideUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw() 
00196 { 
00197     const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize(); 
00198     unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize; 
00199     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize(); 
00200     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData(); 
00201     float* leftOperandSamples = inputs[LeftOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel); 
00202     float* rightOperandSamples = inputs[RightOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel); 
00203     int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize; 
00204     
00205     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0) 
00206     { 
00207         if(numKrSamples == 0) 
00208             value = *leftOperandSamples / *rightOperandSamples; // maybe should "zap" the output?
00209         
00210         numKrSamples        =  krBlockSize - numKrSamples; 
00211         blockPosition       += numKrSamples; 
00212         leftOperandSamples  += numKrSamples; 
00213         rightOperandSamples += numKrSamples; 
00214     
00215         while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) 
00216         { 
00217             *outputSamples++ = value; 
00218             --numSamplesToProcess; 
00219             --numKrSamples; 
00220         } 
00221     }
00222 }

00240 UGenArray UGenArray::operator / (UGenArray const& rightOperand) const throw() 
00241 { 
00242     int size; 
00243     if(internal->size_ > rightOperand.internal->size_) 
00244         size = internal->size_; 
00245     else 
00246         size = rightOperand.internal->size_; 
00247 
00248     UGenArray newArray(size); 
00249 
00250     for(int i = 0; i < size; i++) 
00251     { 
00252         newArray.internal->array[i] = wrapAt(i) / rightOperand.wrapAt(i); 
00253     } 
00254 
00255     return newArray; 
00256 }

00258 Buffer Buffer::operator / (Buffer const& rightOperand) const throw() 
00259 { 
00260     const int newNumChannels = numChannels_ > rightOperand.numChannels_ ? numChannels_ : rightOperand.numChannels_; 
00261     const int maxSize = size_ > rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_; 
00262     const int minSize = size_ < rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_; 
00263     const int diffSize = maxSize-minSize; 
00264     
00265     Buffer newBuffer(maxSize, newNumChannels, false); 
00266     
00267     for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < newNumChannels; channelIndex++) 
00268     { 
00269         int numSamples; 
00270         float* leftSamples = channels[channelIndex % numChannels_]->data; 
00271         float* rightSamples = rightOperand.channels[channelIndex % rightOperand.numChannels_]->data; 
00272         float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data; 
00273         
00274         if(size_ == 1 && numChannels_ == 1) 
00275         { 
00276             numSamples = maxSize; 
00277             while(--numSamples >= 0) 
00278             { 
00279                 *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples / *rightSamples++; 
00280             } 
00281         } 
00282         else if(rightOperand.size_ == 1 && rightOperand.numChannels_ == 1) 
00283         { 
00284             float reciprocalRightOperand = 1.f / *rightSamples;
00285             numSamples = maxSize; 
00286             while(--numSamples >= 0) 
00287             { 
00288                 *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples++ * reciprocalRightOperand; 
00289             } 
00290         } 
00291         else 
00292         { 
00293             numSamples = minSize; 
00294             while(--numSamples >= 0) 
00295             { 
00296                 *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples++ / *rightSamples++; 
00297             } 
00298             
00299             numSamples = diffSize; 
00300             while(--numSamples >= 0) 
00301             { 
00302                 *outputSamples++ = 0.f; 
00303             } 
00304         } 
00305     } 
00306 
00307     return newBuffer; 
00308 }

00323 Value Value::operator / (Value const& rightOperand) const throw()
00324 {
00325     Value TempValue = *this; // copy away const
00326     if(containsInternalType<ValueInternal>() && (TempValue.getValue() == 1.0))
00327     {
00328         if(rightOperand.containsInternalType<UnaryReciprocalValueInternal>())
00329             return (dynamic_cast<UnaryReciprocalValueInternal*>(rightOperand.internal))->getOperand();
00330         else
00331             return rightOperand.reciprocal();
00332     }
00333     else    
00334         return BinaryDivideValue(*this, rightOperand); // default
00335 }

00337 ValueArray operator / (const double leftOperand, ValueArray const& rightOperand) throw()
00338 {
00339     return ValueArray(leftOperand) / rightOperand;
00340 }
00341 
00342 ValueArray ValueArray::operator / (ValueArray const& rightOperand) const throw()
00343 {
00344     if(size() == 0)                                                                                                 
00345         return rightOperand;                                                                                        
00346     else if(rightOperand.size() == 0)                                                                               
00347         return *this;                                                                                               
00348     else {                                                                                                      
00349         const int maxSize = ugen::max(size(), rightOperand.size());                                                 
00350         ValueArray newArray(maxSize);                                                                               
00351         for(int i = 0; i < maxSize; i++) {                                                                          
00352             newArray.put(i, wrapAt(i) / rightOperand.wrapAt(i));                                                
00353         }                                                                                                           
00354         return newArray;                                                                                            
00355     }   
00356 }
